Package com.csse3200.game.win

Class TortoiseLedger

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.win.TortoiseLedger
public final class TortoiseLedger extends Object
Tracks the tortoises hidden across the maps, for the Tortoise Champion honour on the win screen: a player who has found every one of them is a Tortoise Champion, whatever their WinTier.

Not playable yet. No tortoise exists in any map, so getTotal() is 0 and the honour cannot be earned. When tortoises are added, whatever places them calls setTotal(int) with how many the game hides, and whatever lets the player find one calls recordFound(String) with a stable id (the <map name>:<x>,<y> form that kills use works well). Nothing else in the win system needs to change.

The state is static, like EnemyRegistry: the found ids are loaded from the save file when a game is loaded and reset when a new game starts.
